ns2:course.label: ISE Undergraduate Seminar
ns2:course.description: Lecture-discussion series by department faculty and visiting professional engineers addressing ethics, professional registration, the role of technical societies, and the relation of engineering to such disciplines as economics, sociology, and government. Approved for S/U grading only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or Systems Engineering and Design major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: It is recommended this seminar be taken in the sophomore year.
